summary: Plains GP Holdings, L.P. filed an 8-K reporting that its subsidiary Plains All American Pipeline, L.P. completed a $1.5 billion public offering of junior subordinated notes: $700 million of 6.750% Series A Notes due 2056 and $800 million of 7.000% Series B Notes due 2056, both maturing December 15, 2056. Interest pays semi-annually from June 15, 2027, with coupon resets in 2031 and 2036 at the Five-Year Treasury plus a spread, floored at the initial rates. Notes are unsecured, subordinated to senior debt, issued under a new indenture with U.S. Bank Trust as trustee. This is a routine financing, not a special situation; watch leverage, hybrid treatment, and redemption mechanics.
